<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks at 151.28, 134.64, 132.51, 124.01, 123.09, and 122.26 ppm fall within the typical aromatic carbon chemical‑shift ranges (≈115–160 ppm). These six signals correspond to aromatic carbons. The remaining peaks are aliphatic or carbonyl. Therefore, the molecule contains six aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
